note: Unmodified copy of the SNESTang button-image-to-SNES-serial-pad adapter. SN64 uses it through fpga/rtl/sn64_snes_joypad.sv, which fixes the ID nibble, drives the second data line idle (no multitap) and adds an empty-port mode. No vendored file is edited. Kept separate from fpga/vendor/snestang so that directory's provenance record stays untouched.
